files.name: customers.csv
files.row_means: one customer: segment, region, account rep, payment terms, credit limit

files.name: orders.csv
files.row_means: one order line: one product, quantity, list price, discount, unit cost, rep, payment date

files.name: returns.csv
files.row_means: one return: at most one per order, quantity returned, reason, refund

steps.title: Removed duplicate order rows
steps.why: Same order_id with every column identical: the order was counted twice.

steps.title: Converted percent discounts to fractions
steps.why: Most discounts are fractions (0.12). These rows hold 12 for 12%, which made their revenue negative. They sit inside the discount analysis the main finding rests on.
steps.effect: These rows go from -$5,121,624 to $314,759 of revenue

steps.title: Set aside negative quantities for review
steps.why: Each has a payment date and no matching return, so it is neither a clean sale nor a return. Kept in a review list instead of guessing the sign.
steps.effect: Out of the sales view: -$11,522. Jan-Sep revenue growth 33.00% -> 33.03%

steps.title: Unified region spellings
steps.why: 15 spellings (ON, ontario, QC, Québec, B.C., ATL...) for 5 regions.
steps.effect: Total unchanged. Regional totals gain Ontario $93,155, Quebec $75,624, Atlantic $66,814, BC $23,356, Prairies $20,785

steps.title: Unified product names
steps.why: 22 names (Mech Keyboard, 24in Monitor, ERGOLIFT STANDING DESK...) for 10 products.
steps.effect: Total unchanged. $276,774 now lands on the right product

steps.title: Converted MM/DD/YYYY order dates to ISO
steps.why: The rest are YYYY-MM-DD. Read day first, these would put orders in Oct to Dec 2026, after the data ends. So month first.
steps.effect: Total unchanged. $166,793 now falls in the right month and quarter

steps.title: Left blank unit costs blank
steps.why: No invented values. Margins use only rows with a known cost.
steps.effect: Margins computed on 98.5% of order lines

steps.title: Kept blank payment dates
steps.why: All on business orders (Net 30 / Net 60): invoices still unpaid when the data was extracted on 2026-10-31.

steps.title: Checked the joins between the three files
steps.why: orders.customer_id to customers, returns.order_id to orders, order region vs customer region.
steps.effect: 0 orders without a customer, 0 returns without an order, 0 region mismatches
